result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few horizontally clipped and obscured elements make the layout look unfinished.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel extends beyond the right edge of the viewport: the third card, its image, and the name "Trattoria Piccol..." are visibly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has intentional edge treatment and accessible horizontal scrolling, or constrain card widths and add appropriate clipping/padding so partial cards do not look accidentally broken.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation; its image continues under the navigation bar and its title/details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom safe-area padding or page scroll space so the final card can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row also shows a partially visible chip at the far right, which can look like an accidental overflow rather than an intentional horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Use a clear horizontal-scroll affordance or fade/spacing at the edge, and verify that the clipped chip remains fully reachable by touch.
